# Cavalier of Thorns (M20).
# Reach: compiled keyword, kept.
# s2+s3: "When this creature enters, reveal the top five cards of your library. Put a land card from
#   among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your graveyard."
#   REVEAL top N (Tajuru Paragon's B6 reveal) opens the look window; the partition is Waker of
#   Waves's / See the Truth's ONE_OF + REST over Zone(LIBRARY, YOU, TOP) (B5b-one-of-other,
#   B5b-one-of-rest-bottom), the ONE_OF filtered to a land card and sent to the battlefield, the
#   REST to your graveyard.
# s4+s5: "When this creature dies, you may exile it. If you do, put another target card from your
#   graveyard on top of your library."
#   Dies event of Spirit of Malevolence; "You may X. If you do, Y" = Seq(OptionalEffect(X),
#   Conditional(MAY_DONE, Y)). "it" = the event referent (convention C2/C8, Containment Priest's
#   exile action). Y: Epitaph Golem's graveyard-target MOVE_ZONE with "another" = FNot(IS_SOURCE)
#   and "on top of" = position TOP (Teferi, Timeless Voyager).
top_of_library = Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU, position=ZonePosition.TOP)
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.REVEAL, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=5)}),
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ONE_OF,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
                    zones=(top_of_library,),
                ),
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            }),
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.REST,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=(top_of_library,),
                ),
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
dies = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            OptionalEffect(
                inner=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                        referent='event',
                    ),
                }),
            ),
            Conditional(
                pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE),
                then_effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                        filter=FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': top_of_library,
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, dies, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, reveal the top five cards of your library.
Put a land card from among them onto the battlefield and the rest into your graveyard.
When this creature dies, you may exile it.
clauses.ir: abilities[1].event, abilities[1].effect.steps[0] (OptionalEffect MOVE_ZONE event referent -> exile)

clauses.clause: If you do, put another target card from your graveyard on top of your library.
clauses.ir: abilities[1].effect.steps[1] (Conditional MAY_DONE -> MOVE_ZONE target card in your graveyard, not the source -> library TOP)

mapping.notes: ETB: REVEAL 5 + ONE_OF land -> battlefield + REST -> graveyard (Waker of Waves / See the Truth partition). Dies: Seq(OptionalEffect(exile event referent), Conditional(MAY_DONE, target other card in your graveyard -> library TOP)).
